metadata.name: jpui-calendar
metadata.description: A shadcn-styled inline calendar. Renders a month grid for picking a single date or a date range, with full keyboard navigation, min/max and per-date blocking, optional week numbers, multi-month display, and month/year dropdowns. Every visual token — cell size, radius, selected, today, range track, focus ring — is a separate editable style property. Dates are stored as timezone-safe `"YYYY-MM-DD"` strings.
features: Single-date and date-range selection, stored as timezone-safe ISO date strings
Range editing that adjusts the nearest edge instead of restarting: a click before the start moves the start, any other click moves the end, and clicking an endpoint restarts from it
Range mode that draws the middle band once both ends are picked, with a continuous track across week boundaries
Min/max dates, individual blocked dates (hand-entered or mapped from a collection), and blocked weekdays
Minimum and maximum range length, enforced by greying out the days that would violate it
Full keyboard support: arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Shift+PageUp/Down for years, Enter to select, Escape to cancel a pending range
Roving tab stop and a single focusable day, so Tab enters the grid at the selected date
Multi-month display, horizontal or vertical, with optional ISO or locale week numbers
Month and year dropdown captions for fast navigation across long spans
Localized month and weekday names from any BCP-47 tag, with no per-locale bundle cost
Around 47 style properties grouped into collapsible sections, defaulting to the shadcn light theme
Form integration with field naming, required and custom validation, and reset to the initial value

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Selection mode. `"single"` stores one date string, `"range"` stores `{ start, end }`. Switching mode keeps the date — a range collapses to its start.

properties.name: initialValue
properties.description: The value the calendar opens on, and the value a form reset restores. Accepts `"2026-08-14"`, an ISO datetime, a timestamp, a Date, or — in range mode — `{ start, end }`, `{ from, to }` or `[start, end]`.

properties.name: defaultMonth
properties.description: The month shown on first render. Empty opens on the selected value, or on the current month.

properties.name: numberOfMonths
properties.description: How many consecutive months to render side by side, 1 to 12.

properties.name: monthDirection
properties.description: Whether multiple months stack horizontally (`"row"`) or vertically (`"column"`). Only shown when more than one month is displayed.

properties.name: minDate
properties.description: Earliest selectable date. Days before it are disabled and navigation stops at its month.

properties.name: maxDate
properties.description: Latest selectable date. Days after it are disabled and navigation stops at its month.

properties.name: disabledDates
properties.description: Individual dates to block. An array of date strings, or a bound collection mapped with Disabled date field.

properties.name: disabledDaysOfWeek
properties.description: Weekday indexes to block, 0 = Sunday. `[0, 6]` blocks every weekend.

properties.name: mappingDisabledDate
properties.description: Formula resolving the date of each item in Disabled dates. Runs once per item. Hidden until Disabled dates is bound.

properties.name: minRange
properties.description: Minimum inclusive number of days in a range. Days that would make the range too short are greyed out. 0 = no minimum.

properties.name: maxRange
properties.description: Maximum inclusive number of days in a range. Days that would stretch the range past the limit are greyed out. 0 = no maximum.

properties.name: captionLayout
properties.description: The month/year caption: a plain `"label"`, or native selects via `"dropdown"`, `"dropdown-months"`, `"dropdown-years"`.

properties.name: hideNavigation
properties.description: Remove the previous/next arrows. Keyboard navigation still moves between months.

properties.name: fromYear
properties.description: Earliest year offered by the year dropdown.

properties.name: toYear
properties.description: Latest year offered by the year dropdown. The list is capped at 400 entries.

properties.name: showOutsideDays
properties.description: Fill the leading and trailing cells with the neighbouring months’ days.

properties.name: fixedWeeks
properties.description: Always render 6 week rows so the calendar keeps a constant height while navigating.

properties.name: showWeekNumber
properties.description: Show a week-number column on the left of the grid.

properties.name: isoWeek
properties.description: Use ISO-8601 week numbering (weeks start Monday, week 1 contains the first Thursday).

properties.name: locale
properties.description: BCP-47 tag driving month and weekday names, e.g. `"fr-FR"`. Empty follows the browser. An unknown tag silently falls back rather than breaking the grid.

properties.name: weekStartsOn
properties.description: First column of the grid, `"0"` (Sunday) through `"6"` (Saturday).

properties.name: dateFormatStyle
properties.description: How the read-only `formatted` value in local context is rendered: `full | long | medium | short | iso | custom`. Does not affect the stored value. The presets go through `Intl` and follow the Locale property; only `custom` reaches date-fns.

properties.name: customDateFormat
properties.description: A date-fns pattern used when Formatted value is `"custom"`. Month and day names in a custom pattern always render in English, because date-fns locale files are deliberately not bundled — use a preset if you need them localized.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Blocks selection and dims the calendar, adding the `disabled` state.

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Blocks selection but keeps full opacity and keyboard focus, adding the `readonly` state.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Marks the field as required. A range counts as filled only once both ends are set.

properties.name: invalid
properties.description: Forces the `invalid` state. Bind it to a server-side error.

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Accessible name announced for the date grid.

properties.name: fieldName
properties.description: The field name used in the form submission. Only shown inside a form.

properties.name: customValidation
properties.description: Enable a custom validation formula for this field. Only shown inside a form.

properties.name: validation
properties.description: Formula that must resolve truthy for the field to be valid. Only shown when Custom validation is on.

properties.name: widthMode
properties.description: How the calendar's width is decided. 'hug' (default): the calendar is exactly its grid — 7 × cellSize (8 × with week numbers) — and any width set on the element is ignored. 'fill': the calendar takes the width of its container and the 7 (or 8) columns divide it evenly, cells staying square, down to minCellSize.

properties.name: calendarFontFamily
properties.description: Font family for every text in the calendar.

properties.name: monthGap
properties.description: Space between months when more than one is displayed.

properties.name: cellSize
properties.description: The exact square size of a day cell. Cells hold a 1:1 aspect ratio and do not grow with the container, so this also sets the calendar’s width: 7 × this value (8 × with week numbers), plus padding. Below that width the grid overflows rather than compressing. Only applies when widthMode is 'hug'.

properties.name: minCellSize
properties.description: The smallest a day cell may get while widthMode is 'fill'. Cells grow past it freely as the container widens; below it the grid overflows rather than compressing further. Also sets the size of the nav buttons. Only applies when widthMode is 'fill'.

properties.name: cellRadius
properties.description: Corner radius of a day cell and its selection pill.

properties.name: weekGap
properties.description: Vertical space between week rows.

properties.name: captionFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the month/year caption.

properties.name: captionFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of the month/year caption.

properties.name: captionColor
properties.description: Text color of the month/year caption.

properties.name: navIconPrev
properties.description: Icon for the previous-month button. Empty uses the built-in chevron.

properties.name: navIconNext
properties.description: Icon for the next-month button. Empty uses the built-in chevron.

properties.name: navIconSize
properties.description: Size of the navigation icons.

properties.name: navIconColor
properties.description: Color of the navigation icons.

properties.name: navBgColor
properties.description: Background of the navigation buttons.

properties.name: navHoverBgColor
properties.description: Background of the navigation buttons on hover.

properties.name: navHoverIconColor
properties.description: Icon color of the navigation buttons on hover.

properties.name: navBorderRadius
properties.description: Corner radius of the navigation buttons.

properties.name: weekdayFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the weekday header row.

properties.name: weekdayFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of the weekday header row.

properties.name: weekdayColor
properties.description: Text color of the weekday header row.

properties.name: dayFontSize
properties.description: Font size of a day number.

properties.name: dayFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of a day number.

properties.name: dayColor
properties.description: Text color of an unselected day.

properties.name: dayHoverBgColor
properties.description: Background of the day under the cursor. Today, selected and range days keep their own colors on hover.

properties.name: dayHoverColor
properties.description: Text color of the day under the cursor.

properties.name: selectedBgColor
properties.description: Background of the selected day in single mode.

properties.name: selectedColor
properties.description: Text color of the selected day in single mode.

properties.name: selectedHoverBgColor
properties.description: Background of the selected day on hover.

properties.name: todayBgColor
properties.description: Background of today’s cell.

properties.name: todayColor
properties.description: Text color of today’s cell.

properties.name: todayFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of today’s cell.

properties.name: rangeEndpointBgColor
properties.description: Background of the range start and end pills.

properties.name: rangeEndpointColor
properties.description: Text color of the range start and end pills.

properties.name: rangeMiddleBgColor
properties.description: Background of the continuous track between the range endpoints.

properties.name: rangeMiddleColor
properties.description: Text color of the days inside the range track.

properties.name: outsideDayColor
properties.description: Text color of days belonging to the neighbouring months.

properties.name: disabledDayColor
properties.description: Text color of a disabled day.

properties.name: disabledDayOpacity
properties.description: Opacity of a disabled day, 0 to 1.

properties.name: weekNumberColor
properties.description: Text color of the week-number column.

properties.name: weekNumberFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the week-number column.

properties.name: focusRingColor
properties.description: Color of the keyboard focus ring.

properties.name: focusRingWidth
properties.description: Width of the keyboard focus ring.

properties.name: invalidBorderColor
properties.description: Border color of the calendar in the invalid state.

properties.name: invalidRingColor
properties.description: Ring color of the calendar in the invalid state.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: A day button holds keyboard focus. Matched by `&:focus-visible, &:has(:focus-visible)` — the browser decides keyboard vs mouse, the component tracks nothing.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Selection is blocked. Matched by `&[aria-disabled="true"]` (and `&[data-ww-disabled="true"]`, the editing-mode stand-in).

states.name: readonly
states.description: Selection is blocked but the calendar stays fully visible and focusable. Matched by `&[aria-readonly="true"]`.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The value failed validation, or the Invalid property forced it. Matched by `&[aria-invalid="true"]`.

events.name: change
events.description: The stored value changed, from a click, a keyboard selection or an action.

events.name: initValueChange
events.description: The Initial value property changed and was written to the variable.

events.name: dayClick
events.description: A selectable day was clicked or activated. Fires before the value updates.

events.name: rangeComplete
events.description: Both ends of a range are now set. Range mode only.

events.name: monthChange
events.description: The displayed month changed, from the arrows, the dropdowns, keyboard navigation or an action.

actions.label: Set value
actions.description: Write a value, normalised to the current mode.

args.name: Value
args.description: A date string, Date, timestamp, or `{ start, end }` in range mode.

actions.label: Reset value
actions.description: Restore the Initial value and clear the interacted flag that drives required validation.

actions.label: Clear value
actions.description: Empty the selection. In range mode both ends are cleared.

actions.label: Go to month
actions.description: Display the month containing the given date. Does not change the selection.

args.name: Month
args.description: Any date inside the target month, e.g. `"2026-09-01"`.

actions.label: Next month
actions.description: Advance the displayed month by one, stopping at Max date.

actions.label: Previous month
actions.description: Go back one month, stopping at Min date.

actions.label: Go to today
actions.description: Display the current month. Does not select today.

actions.label: Focus
actions.description: Move keyboard focus to the active day button.

variables.name: value
variables.description: The selection. A `"YYYY-MM-DD"` string in single mode, `{ start, end }` in range mode. Either may be null.

localContext.description: Everything the calendar knows about its own state.

value.description: The stored selection, same as the `value` variable.

formatted.description: The selection rendered with the Formatted value setting. A string in single mode, `{ start, end }` in range mode.

displayedMonth.description: First day of the month currently shown, as `"YYYY-MM-01"`.

specifications: CRITICAL: states are selector-based, not emit-based. The component sets `aria-disabled` / `aria-readonly` / `aria-invalid` on its root and WeWeb generates the CSS from the selectors in `states`. There is no `add-state` / `remove-state` emission — do not add one.

CRITICAL: every style-panel property goes through the top-level `css()` hook, which emits one `--jpc-*` custom property per setting. The scoped SCSS reads them as `var(--jpc-x, <default>)`. Do not move these into an inline `:style` — the style compiler owns them, and an inline binding would ship only the base value and silently drop every per-state, per-breakpoint and per-class variant.

On the WeWeb canvas the day buttons drop their real `disabled` attribute (a disabled control suppresses the click the editor needs to select the element) and expose `data-ww-disabled` instead. In preview and in production the real attribute is back.

Day cells hold a 1:1 aspect ratio. It is set on the day `<button>`, never on the `<td>`: `aspect-ratio` does not apply to internal table boxes and is silently ignored there — verified in Chromium, where a `<td>` with `aspect-ratio: 1; width: 70px` measures 70 × 2.

CRITICAL: the calendar declares no background, padding, border or border-radius of its own. Those belong to WeWeb's element style panel on the root — a component-level duplicate put two competing sources on the same CSS properties. Style the box from the element panel, not from the Calendar group, which now only carries Font family and Month gap.

The calendar sizes itself with `width: max-content` — it hugs its grid rather than stretching, so a day cell is exactly Cell size at any container width and the element is always 7 x Cell size wide (8 x with week numbers). `max-content` rather than `fit-content` is deliberate: `fit-content` clamps to the available space, which made the box narrower than the table inside it, so the grid spilled out of its own background and any fit-content ancestor measured the shrunken box instead of the visible calendar.

CRITICAL: the calendar never compresses — `table-layout: fixed` will not shrink a column below its declared width. Size the parent from the calendar, not the reverse: give the container fit-content (Hug), or a fixed width of at least 7 x Cell size plus its own padding, or lower Cell size. In a narrower container the whole element overflows as one block, background included.

CRITICAL: dates are stored as date-only strings (`"2026-08-14"`), never as Date objects or ISO timestamps. This is deliberate — a timestamp read back in another timezone lands on the wrong day. Compare and bind against the string.
CRITICAL: this is an inline calendar with no built-in popover. To build a date-picker dropdown, place it inside a WeWeb dropdown or dialog and drive that element from the `change` event.
In range mode the value is `{ start, end }`. `end` is null while the user is mid-selection, so guard on `range.isComplete` (or `end`) before using the range.
Clicking a day before the pending start restarts the range from that day. Escape cancels a pending range entirely.
Min/max range length is enforced visually: the days that would violate it are disabled while a start is pending, so a click on them does nothing.
Clicking the already-selected day in single mode clears it, unless Required is on.
Only Default month re-anchors the view. Writing to the value from a workflow deliberately does not scroll the grid — call the Go to month action if you want both.

The Locale property drives month and weekday names through the browser’s Intl, so any BCP-47 tag works without a bundle cost. A custom date format pattern, by contrast, renders its month and day names in English.
Multi-month display renders consecutive months from the anchor. Each month gets its own caption dropdowns; changing one shifts the whole anchor so the months stay consecutive.
The calendar has one tab stop. Tab enters at the focused day, else the selected day, else today, else the first day of the month; arrows move within and across months.

examples.description: A booking calendar: pick a stay of 2 to 14 nights, no dates in the past, weekends blocked.
A date of birth picker with month and year dropdowns.
A compact European calendar with ISO week numbers.
